quest.title: Dimming Mushroom's Call for Help
quest.description: You hear strange sounds — voices, almost — coming from a giant mushroom in The Chasm. Could it be... a giant talking mushroom?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: How curious! This two-legged hatchling makes no use of her feet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Two-legged hatchling"? Hmph, Paimon's got a name! And looks like someone's gonna get themselves the silliest nickname in the world ever!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon think... You know what, we're gonna call you "Sheeshroom"!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Also, look at this glowing powder in the air. Are they mushroom spores? Paimon wonders if they're the reason why we could hear this mushroom talking.

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: Xamaran knows many legged ones who make no use of their feet. Yet Xamaran knows not any Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, that's natural, because Paimon is one of a kind.

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: Xamaran knows the two-legged one over there. How strangely familiar.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, do you know Sheeshroom?

response.speaker: Xamaran
response.text: Xamaran smells the heat of golden sand and the dampness from deep within the rainforest. That's the smell of Xamaran's hometown.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hot sand and the rainforest? Do you mean Sumeru? We did just talk to a Sumeru scholar at the camp...

response.speaker: Xamaran
response.text: Although Xamaran has been away from its hometown for long, Xamaran makes no mistakes.

response.speaker: Xamaran
response.text: #{NICKNAME} the Two-Legged, fate has brought you here. Xamaran has a favor to ask.

response.speaker: Xamaran
response.text: Xamaran has dwelled here for many a year and found it a cozy and comfy home...

response.speaker: Xamaran
response.text: Yet foul energy is growing lately. Xamaran has been drained of strength fending off the evil and has ended up in this state. Xamaran must seek help from the two-legged.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sheeshroom does look a little under the weather...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hm... Oh right, {NICKNAME}, we can lend the energy of the Adjuvant to Sheeshroom, perhaps? Maybe that'll make it feel better.

choices.text: Maybe I do, but I don't remember.

talks.objective: Give Xamaran some of the Adjuvant's power

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You lend the energy of the Adjuvant to Xamaran.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Sheeshroom is glowing. Should Paimon call it a "Shiningroom" now?

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: #Hail {NICKNAME}! Hail Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: #Thanks to {NICKNAME}, and thanks to Paimon also! Xamaran life-light is rekindled!

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: But do not let your guard down yet. Xamaran knows that the foul energy is not yet eradicated. It could strike back at any time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Then what do we do!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Where did all this black mud come from? Is it the "foul energy" that Sheeshroom talked about?

talks.objective: Help Xamaran clear the foul energy out

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: #Hail {NICKNAME}! Hail Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: If Xamaran may be so bold, you Two-Legs do have a saying: "A helping hand must see things to the end."

response.speaker: Xamaran
response.text: Amongst Two-Legs, you two do indeed deserve the title of "The Wise."

response.speaker: Xamaran
response.text: Please take this — the Blessings of Wisdom.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You obtain the Blessings of Wisdom.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... What's this? It looks kinda suspicious, actually...

response.speaker: Xamaran
response.text: Xamaran can smell the lingering scent of foul energy in the air but cannot tell where its source lies. Follow the water and you shall find it.

response.speaker: Xamaran
response.text: #You merely need to use the Blessings of Wisdom on the source, {NICKNAME}, and Xamaran's kin will take care of the rest.

choices.text: The source of the foul energy... That's indeed something that can't be left unattended.

response.speaker: Xamaran
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, you are far more humorous than Paimon. Xamaran doesn't have legs whereas you do. As one of the legless, Xamaran shan't meddle too much with the matters of the Two-Legs.

response.speaker: Xamaran
response.text: What's more, Xamaran has a greater duty to perform.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A greater duty?

response.speaker: Xamaran
response.text: Xamaran has spent too much strength. It was a pleasant conversation with you two, but Xamaran must rest now and gather the strength to fend off evil and provide a shelter for its kin to prosper.

response.speaker: Xamaran
response.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon, may you be blessed on your journey ahead.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, Sheeshroom! Wake up!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, looks like Sheeshroom has gone to sleep. Well, let's head off then.

choices.text: ...But why don't you deal with it yourself?
But do human sayings really apply to mushrooms?

response.speaker: Xamaran
response.text: We are both living beings bathing in the blessings of the earth. It's natural for us to help each other out.

talks.objective: Tell Xamaran that the foul energy has been cleansed

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: #Hail {NICKNAME}! Hail Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: None answered Xamaran's call for help. The many-legged and four-legged paid no heed, and the two-legged turned a deaf ear.

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: #Only the wise would answer. Paimon proved to be one with wisdom, and {NICKNAME} did, too.

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: You two, wisest of the two-legged, shall receive Xamaran's gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, Paimon the Wise is not to be taken lightly!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was no trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: #Given time, {NICKNAME} and Paimon will rise to become as great as Xamaran and its kin. This Xamaran knows for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hang on, what is that supposed to mean?

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: The many-legged are inferior to the four-legged, and the four-legged are inferior to the two-legged, so naturally, the two-legged are inferior to the legless.

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: #But what {NICKNAME} and Paimon lack by nature, you can make up for through hard work. You might even be able to change the course of fate one day.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, this glowing mushroom's talking super big! Paimon wonders if glowing mushrooms make good cooking ingredients...

response.speaker: Xamaran
response.text: A glutton, this Paimon is. A bite on the mushroom today, another bite tomorrow, and a hundred days later, there shall be no Paimon left in Paimon, but only mushrooms.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Uhh, Sheeshroom's starting to talk all creepy, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Xamaran
response.text: Ah, so you failed to see the humor in that. A shame.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That wasn't funny at all!

response.speaker: Xamaran
response.text: Xamaran is cleared of the foul energy, yet its kin still suffer. Xamaran lacks the strength now to shelter the weak like it once did.

response.speaker: Xamaran
response.text: #Please, {NICKNAME}, Xamaran begs of you. Exercise your benevolence and save the defenseless.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Do you mean there are more ill mushrooms? {NICKNAME}, let's help 'em, shall we?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then let's be off!

choices.text: As long as it's not a big detour.
Beautiful mushrooms lie. This one could be poisonous.

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: Xamaran knows that the foul energy has yet to be eradicated. Two-legged one, please lend Xamaran your strength.

talks.objective: Follow the water's flow and search for the source of the foul energy
Use the Blessings of Wisdom on the source of the foul energy
Tell Xamaran that the foul energy's source has been cleared out

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Sheeshroom, we're back. We've run out of your — um, what do you call it — oh, your Blessings of Wisdom.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But we've managed to block the fissures. Now the problem has been solved!

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: #Hail {NICKNAME}! Hail Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: May no regrets linger in the night bygone. May all shadows fade ere the dawn to come.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems Sheeshroom has fallen asleep again. Let's not disturb it.
